subject: general
question: Which player holds the record for most runs (6411) in Indian Premier League (IPL) (as of July 2022)?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Virat Kohli__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The flamboyant and fearless, top-order Indian batsman** Virat Kohli gets 1st place in terms of scoring the most runs in IPL, with 6411 runs in 216 Matches (208 innings)**.
 
• Making his **IPL debut for Royal Challengers Bangalore in 2008**, Kohli has played all IPL games for RCB so far and** averaged 36.43** in the event.
 
• The modern-day great also holds the record of amassing the **most runs in a single IPL season, 973 runs in 16 matches in 2016.**
 
• Unfortunately, despite being one of the best, Virat Kohli is yet to win an IPL trophy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
